title: Client-side and server-side
subtitle: Not everything can run in a browser. Here's why we use a hybrid approach.

client.title: Client-side tools
client.desc: These tools run entirely in your browser using pdf-lib. Your files are never uploaded.
client.guaranteeDesc: Zero network requests for file data. Nothing leaves your browser.

server.title: Server-side tools
server.desc: These require heavy computation that browsers can't handle efficiently. We use a Python backend.
server.guaranteeDesc: Uploaded files are automatically deleted from the server after delivery.
